headline: Barilla Hellas: Turnover reaches €139.6 million in 2025 – Stronger profitability and investment in Greece
summary: Barilla Hellas reported 2025 turnover of €139.6 million and said it recorded significant growth despite ongoing challenges. The company also highlighted stronger profitability and continued investment in Greece.
why: Barilla is a major Italian pasta and food group, and its Greek subsidiary's results indicate performance in the Greek packaged food market.
